WizardArchetype.AbilityX.BuffDesc: The rift is torn open. Your next wizard spell is empowered: larger damage dice, {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g} rolled multiple times taking the lowest, automatic bypass of {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}, and broken descriptor immunities. Once the empowerment is spent you immediately become temporally staggered for 1 round (one move or one standard action each round, movement speed halved).
WizardArchetype.AbilityX.Desc:
A rift mage can tear a brief seam in reality and let causality fail before it. As a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g}, the next {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} cast within 3 rounds is empowered.
An empowered spell improves with {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}: damage dice increase by 2 (by 4 at level 5, by 6 at level 10); enemies roll their {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throw{/g} twice and take the lower result (3 rolls at level 5, 4 rolls at level 10); the spell also automatically overcomes {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g} and breaks descriptor-based immunities.
Only non-cantrip spells cast from a wizard spellbook are empowered. If no qualifying spell is cast within 3 rounds the state ends, and the use is not refunded.
As a cost, the moment the spell finishes the mage immediately becomes temporally staggered for 1 round (as staggered: one move or one standard action each round, movement speed halved).
One use is restored after each rest.
WizardArchetype.AbilityX.Name: Rift Annihilation
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Cancel.Desc:
Immediately remove the current caster level and DC adjustments; stacks drop to 0.
Free action, costs 1 use.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Cancel.Name: Release Attunement
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Desc:
In combat a rift mage can shift the phase of their own magic. As a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, choose to raise {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} or raise {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g}; the effect lasts until combat ends.
Raising caster level gives +1 caster level and -2 DC to wizard spells; raising DC gives +2 DC and -1 caster level.
The same kind of effect stacks up to 2 times; while one is active the other cannot be chosen. It only affects {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} from the wizard spellbook.
In combat the mage may also spend a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g} and 1 use to end an active adjustment early.
After each rest, uses are restored to ⌈{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier / 2⌉ + ⌈{g|Encyclopedia:Class_Level}class level{/g} / 2⌉.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Down.Desc:
For this combat, wizard spells gain +2 {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} but take -1 {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}.
Can be used again to stack the same effect (up to 2). While active, Raise Caster Level cannot be chosen.
Swift action, only in combat.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Down.Name: Raise Difficulty
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Name: Rift Attunement
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.ResourceDesc: Restored after each rest: ⌈{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier / 2⌉ + ⌈{g|Encyclopedia:Class_Level}class level{/g} / 2⌉.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Up.Desc:
For this combat, wizard spells gain +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} but take -2 {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g}.
Can be used again to stack the same effect (up to 2). While active, Raise Difficulty cannot be chosen.
Swift action, only in combat.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.Up.Name: Raise Caster Level
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.YDown.Desc:
Wizard spells have higher saving throw DC and lower caster level.
Per stack: +2 DC / -1 caster level. Stacks are shown at the lower right of the icon.
Caused by Rift Attunement; removed when combat ends.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.YDown.Name: Raise Difficulty
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.YUp.Desc:
Wizard spells have higher caster level and lower saving throw DC.
Per stack: +1 caster level / -2 DC. Stacks are shown at the lower right of the icon.
Caused by Rift Attunement; removed when combat ends.
WizardArchetype.AbilityY.YUp.Name: Raise Caster Level
WizardArchetype.AbilityZ.Desc:
A rift mage burns their own anchor to reality, forcing a seam open and buying one more burst. As a full-round action, restore 1 charge of Rift Annihilation.
As a cost the mage gains 30 seconds of exhausted and 90 seconds of fatigued at the same time: exhausted ends after 30 seconds while the fatigue continues for 60 more. Neither is removed early when combat ends.
Usable only when Rift Annihilation has no charges left.
Gained at base {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} 7: 1 use per rest at 7-11, 2 at 12-16, 3 at 17 or higher.
WizardArchetype.AbilityZ.Name: Rift Overdraw
WizardArchetype.AbilityZ.ResourceDesc: Base caster level 7-11: 1 use; 12-16: 2; 17+: 3. Restored after each rest.
WizardArchetype.Archetype.Desc:
Rift mages chase the seams of reality that open between one instant and the next.
They give up traditional schools and arcane bonds, trading nerve and bodily backlash for bursts that break causality and spellcasting that is almost instinctive.
WizardArchetype.Archetype.Name: Rift Mage
WizardArchetype.Concentration.Desc: A rift mage has learned to steady their mana circuit in the gaps where reality breaks. {g|Encyclopedia:Concentration}Concentration{/g} checks gain a bonus equal to {g|Encyclopedia:Class_Level}class level{/g} + 1, up to a maximum of +6.
WizardArchetype.Concentration.Name: Rift Mind
WizardArchetype.HareFamiliar.Desc: A bonded hare that crawled out of a seam in reality follows the rift mage. It grants no {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} or skill bonuses of its own — its purpose is to be the link between the mage and the fractures in time, and all related bonuses come from the Lucky Hare feature itself.
WizardArchetype.HareFamiliar.Name: Lucky Hare
WizardArchetype.HareUnified.Desc:
A bonded hare crawls out of a seam in reality and becomes the rift mage's familiar. It grants no bonuses itself; it exists as a link between the mage and the fractures in time.
From class level 3, the rift mage gains +2 on {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} checks to overcome {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}.
From class level 7, the hare twitches its ears before time actually passes, letting the mage roll {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} twice and keep the higher result. This applies to initiative checks only, not to other checks or attacks.
WizardArchetype.HareUnified.Name: Lucky Hare
WizardArchetype.InitiativeDouble.Desc: From class level 7 the bonded hare twitches its ears before time actually passes. The rift mage rolls {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} twice and keeps the higher result. This applies to initiative checks only, not to other checks or attacks.
WizardArchetype.InitiativeDouble.Name: Lucky Hare: Temporal Premonition
WizardArchetype.Insight.Desc: The rift mage's nerves are warped, always acting a step before reality closes. {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}Initiative{/g} checks gain half the {g|Encyclopedia:Class_Level}class level{/g} (max +10). In addition the {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier is added to initiative, but that part cannot exceed class level.
WizardArchetype.Insight.Name: Keen Reflex
WizardArchetype.OpeningTiming.Desc: A rift mage is always half a beat behind reality when battle begins. On entering combat, they fall into one of the following states for 1 round, chosen by the relative {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} of both sides: If their initiative is not lower than the highest enemy initiative, they fall into temporal focus — before casting a wizard spell they must pass a concentration check with DC equal to 10 + ⌈class level / 2⌉ + spell level × 2; on success the spell is cast normally and the state ends immediately, on failure the spell is lost and the mage takes 1d2 {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} damage (at most once per round); if their Constitution drops below 3 they cannot cast any wizard spell while it lasts. If their initiative is lower than any enemy's, they fall into temporal stagger — as staggered: one move or one standard action per round, no full-round actions, but free and swift actions work normally. Temporal stagger halves movement speed; temporal focus does not. Neither can be prevented or removed by Freedom of Movement or similar effects.
WizardArchetype.OpeningTiming.Name: Opening Tempo
WizardArchetype.PerceptionInt.Desc: A rift mage replaces fuzzy intuition with strict causal reasoning. On {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill{/g} checks (Perception, Lore: Nature, Lore: Religion), if their {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} is higher than Wisdom, the Intelligence modifier replaces the Wisdom modifier.
WizardArchetype.PerceptionInt.Name: Keen Deduction
WizardArchetype.QuickenCostNote.Desc: A rift mage casts by instinct, lowering the quicken cost of {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} as {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} rises: +3 from level 13, +2 from level 15, +1 from level 17. This stacks with Favorite Metamagic: Quicken, and the final spell level cost can go as low as 0.
WizardArchetype.QuickenCostNote.Name: Quicken Mastery
WizardArchetype.SpecialEntangled.Desc: Reality has tightened its tolerance for the rift mage's mana circuit. Before casting a wizard {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} while affected, the mage must pass a {g|Encyclopedia:Concentration}concentration{/g} check with {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} equal to 10 + ⌈{g|Encyclopedia:Class_Level}class level{/g} / 2⌉ + spell level × 2. On success the spell is cast normally and this state ends immediately; on failure the spell is lost and the mage takes 1d2 {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} damage (at most once per round); if their Constitution drops below 3 they cannot cast any wizard spell while it lasts.
WizardArchetype.SpecialEntangled.Name: Temporal Focus
WizardArchetype.SpecialStaggered.Desc: Reality is pushing back against every crack in the rift mage. As staggered: one move or one standard action per round, movement speed halved, no {g|Encyclopedia:Full_Round_Action}full-round actions{/g}, but {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free actions{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift actions{/g} work normally. This state cannot be prevented or removed by Freedom of Movement or similar effects.
WizardArchetype.SpecialStaggered.Name: Temporal Stagger
WizardArchetype.SpellPen.Desc: The bonded hare can smell the gaps in the folds of reality. From class level 3, the rift mage gains +2 on {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} checks to overcome {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}spell resistance{/g}.
WizardArchetype.SpellPen.Name: Lucky Hare: Rift Instinct
